subject: Request: one-time onramp credit for lapsed POC - QuantaWorks
messages:
From: Ryan Lee <ryan@quantaworks.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: POC expired — request for a short bridge credit

Hi Marissa,

Quick note — our POC with Redwood hit the trial expiry on Friday and the sandbox is now locked. We were in the middle of performance tuning and a short gap means the team loses momentum.

Can Redwood provide a small one-time reactivation credit so we can finish the evaluation? Ideally ~30k tokens (~$300) or an equivalent short-term sandbox access window would get us to a decision. We submitted the attached POC evaluation summary that shows where we landed.

Expectations: if we can run the remaining edge-case tests this week we can finalize the internal buy decision in early September.

Thanks — let me know what you can do.

Ryan Lee
Head of ML — QuantaWorks
ryan@quantaworks.com
+1 415-555-0162

Attachment: POC-eval-summary.pdf (1.2MB)
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Ryan Lee <ryan@quantaworks.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC expired — request for a short bridge credit

Hi Ryan — thanks for the summary and context. Sorry to hear the timing cut off your work. I pulled the attached evaluation and it looks like you got through the main perf scenarios.

I can typically authorize small onramp credits for active POCs, but for anything outside standard promo windows I need a quick sign-off from Ops/Finance. I will:
- Flag this to Ben (cc'd) for a one-time $300 credit approval.
- If approved, we'll provision a temporary sandbox token and send a verification checklist so you can resume tests immediately.

Before I escalate, can you confirm:
1) Which team members need access (emails)
2) Are there any compliance artifacts we need to re-share (SOC2/retention)?
3) Do you anticipate needing more than 30k tokens in the next 30 days?

If you can reply quickly I will push this through today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Subject: Internal: approval request — one-off onramp credit for QuantaWorks (RW-9821)

Ben / Stephanie — looping you for a quick exception.

They need ~30k tokens (~$300) to finish validation; sales says there is a high likelihood of conversion in early September if we unblock them. They attached an eval summary and a draft SOW which looks reasonable.

Risk: low — commercial, non-sensitive workload. Customer has asked for minimal reactivation to finish tests.

Request: one-time $300 promo credit, valid for 30 days from issuance, single-use sandbox token tied to their account. If approved, I'll communicate terms and send a quick usage checklist.

Attachments: internal_approval_request.docx (approval form filled)

Questions:
- Ben: do we need a billing hold or PO before applying the credit?
- Stephanie: any compliance flags we should attach to the customer record?

Timing: the customer requested a same-day decision; would like to finalize by EOD Thu 8/27.

Thanks,
Marissa

- One-time promo credit equivalent to $300 (30k tokens), expiring 2026-09-28.
